ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominant low-intensity pixel density (black) with a minimal high-intensity component (under 5%) localized as diffuse gray near the peduncle junction and lower-left margin.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pigmented field across >95% of the visible area. A mid-intensity gray cluster is localized at the inferior central axis (base) and extends slightly along the proximal edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire superior margin. Peaks are more pronounced and irregular at the terminal distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave upward sweep from the distal tips towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast off-white pixel clusters visible at the distal extremities of both the left and right lobes, showing irregular, bunched textures.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular erosion and micro-notching along the distal margins, particularly a distinct indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
